$comment: Copy this file to .claude/task-master.config.json in your project and customize

tests.$comment-tests: For monorepos: the quality gate will auto-scope to the affected package when possible (turbo run test --filter=<pkg>). The command here is the fallback used when scope cannot be determined. Always include concurrency flags to prevent spawning unlimited workers and crashing the machine.
tests.$comment-jest: If using Jest instead of Vitest, use: pnpm test -- --maxWorkers=2
